reviewNote: Roamr Pro unlocks starting a group trip (Go together, the people button on the Track tab) and the monthly recap (History › Monthly). Settings › Roamr Pro shows the plans. The free 1-week trial is Apple's introductory offer; Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen. The one-time Lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.roamr.pro) is offered alongside.
